mathematical_definition: (close - close.shift(20)) / rolling(20).std(close) -- the 20-bar price excursion (close vs. its value 20 bars ago) scaled by the trailing 20-bar close volatility, guarded to NaN where that std is ~0
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first 20 bars (rolling(20).std and the 20-bar shift both need 20 bars); NaN where the rolling std is <= 1e-9 (guarded via np.where), never zero-filled
